title: Modules
summary: Equipment that changes a skill. Equipping costs module energy (raised in the Upgrade Shop).

sections.note: “Effect (data)” is read from the module’s customisation rows: × values are multipliers, + values are as stored.

rows.caption: Absorb Mode Total Battery Gauge Increase

rows: Increases the total battery gauge in Absorb Mode by a specific amount.

rows.caption: Absorb Mode Perfect Judgment Duration Increase

rows: Increases the duration of perfect judgment in Absorb Mode.

rows.caption: Absorb Mode Battery Recovery Speed Increase

rows: Increases the battery gauge recovery speed in Absorb Mode.
Increases Cinderella's HP recovery when she heals naturally.
Increases the duration of Invincibility after Cinderella is hit.
Slightly increases the amount of gold obtained from defeating enemies.
Allows Cinderella to be temporarily invincible while dashing.
Reduces the cooldown time of Dash.

rows.caption: Glass Slippers A Projectile Speed Increase

rows: Slightly increases the projectile speed of basic attacks.
Slightly increases the projectile ATK of basic attacks.

rows.caption: Glass Slippers A Skill Cooldown Reduction

rows: Slightly reduces the cooldown time of Glass Slippers B.
Slightly increases the ATK of Glass Slippers B.

rows.caption: Glass Slippers B Multi-Hit Interval Reduction

rows: Slightly reduces the interval between the multiple hits of Glass Slippers B's subsequent explosions.

rows.caption: Glass Slippers B Additional Pierce Increase

rows: Allows the projectile of Glass Slippers B to pierce once.

rows.caption: Glass Slippers B Projectile Speed Increase

rows: Slightly increases the projectile speed of Glass Slippers B.

rows.caption: Glass Slippers C Skill Cooldown Reduction

rows: Slightly reduces the cooldown time of Glass Slippers C.

rows.caption: Glass Slippers C Laser Range Increase

rows: Slightly increases the laser range of Glass Slippers C.

rows.caption: Glass Slippers C Angle Adjustment Addition

rows: Allows Glass Slippers C to aim in a specific direction before firing.

rows.caption: Glass Slippers C Laser Duration Increase

rows: Slightly increases the laser duration of Glass Slippers C.

rows.caption: Glass Slippers C Movement Speed Increase

rows: Slightly increases the movement speed of Glass Slippers C.

rows.caption: Glass Slippers C Interruption Addition (Cooldown when disabled)

rows: Allows Glass Slippers C to be turned on or off.
Slightly reduces the cooldown time of Glass Slippers D.

rows.caption: Glass Slippers D Auto-Aim Setting Addition

rows: Allows Glass Slippers D to auto-aim and attack Raptures.
Increases the number of projectiles fired by Glass Slippers D.
Increases the number of laser beams fired while Burst is in effect.
Reduces the cooldown time when using Burst again.
Slightly increases the laser range of Burst.
